# Vendored third-party files

These files are copied from `node_modules` by `npm run build:vendor` so the app
makes no CDN requests at runtime. Don't edit them by hand: bump the version in
`package.json`, run `npm install && npm run build`, and commit the result.

| Directory | Package | Version | License |
| :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `lucide/` | [lucide](https://lucide.dev) | 1.62.0 | ISC ([LICENSE](lucide/LICENSE)) |
| `canvas-confetti/` | [canvas-confetti](https://github.com/catdad/canvas-confetti) | 1.9.4 | ISC ([LICENSE](canvas-confetti/LICENSE)) |
| `inter/` | [@fontsource-variable/inter](https://fontsource.org/fonts/inter) (Inter by Rasmus Andersson) | 5.3.0 | SIL OFL 1.1 ([LICENSE](inter/LICENSE)) |

`assets/app.css` is generated by Tailwind CSS 3.4.19 (MIT) from `src/input.css`.
